name: Harolt
source:
"Women should shut up and listen to men, stupid!"

He has a refreshing personality with no hints of sarcasm. While he's surprisingly good at looking after others, he's basically impatient and gets angry easily. Also has the tendency to act on impulse, and often gets reprimanded by the people around him. He's very concerned about his childish personality and appearance, and he wants to grow up as quickly as possible.
